youtube_short.title: The IRS Secretly Owns 22% of Your 401k
title_alternatives: Your 401k Balance Is a Lie — The IRS Owns Part of It
Nobody Tells You This About Your 401k Savings
youtube_short.description: You've been watching your 401k grow for years — but every dollar in a traditional 401k went in before taxes, which means the IRS has never gotten its cut. At a 22% effective rate, $66,000 of a $300,000 balance already belongs to the government. And at age 73, required minimum distributions force you to start withdrawing whether you need the money or not — which can push you into an even higher tax bracket. The Roth IRA flips this: you pay tax now on the seed, and every dollar of growth comes out completely tax-free, with no forced withdrawals. Your conversion window is ages 60 to 72, before RMDs take control. Talk to a tax advisor about whether converting now — while you're in a lower bracket — makes sense for you. Follow for the money traps nobody warns you about. #personalfinance #401k #rothira #retirement #taxes #moneytips
